notes.title: S.T.A.L.K.E.R. 2 is being developed in the Unreal Engine
notes.notes:
Like a brief flicker of life in a dead Bloodsucker s eyes, the S.T.A.L.K.E.R. 2 Twitter account popped up with an announcement this week. The sequel is still being developed, and it s being made in the Unreal Engine, the pixel powerhouse behind such games as Fortnite and uh Bacon Man: An Adventure. Developers GSC Game World seem to be getting awfully cosy with Epic Games, name-dropping them in the announcement as colleagues . I can download the engine for free right now, but I wouldn t dare to call Tim Sweeney a colleague if he hadn t personally shown up at my house and helped to arrange my desk.

(more…)

notes.title: Patch v1.20 Released!
notes.notes:
Today we are releasing the Bacon Man 1.20 patch. The aim of this update is to improve frame-rate, and of course fix bugs. 

Thank you everyone for submitting bugs to us over Steam and Discord. We will continue to patch the game to make the experience the best possible.

[h1]CHANGES[/h1]
[list]
[*] Preparations made for new languages.
[*] Preparations made for new content.
[*] Close to 50 different bugs squashed.
[*] Bacon Man now runs on on the latest Unreal Engine version 4.19.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.10 Released!
notes.notes:
Today we are releasing a new patch for Bacon Man! This patch is primarily small quality and bug fixes. Thank you everyone for submitting bugs to us over Steam and Discord. We will continue to patch the game to make the experience the best possible.

[h1]ADDITIONS[/h1]
[list]
[*] Lard Lass’ throw down and throw in air now has visual effects.
[*] Lard Lass’ throw down impact now has visual effects.
[*] Feta’s Ground Pound has an impact sound effect.
[*] Snow Troopers have full sound effects and visual effects support for their swords.
[*] Improved look for on-screen XP gained text.
[*] World 1 Level 3 - Missing wall collision. Removed old code and unused meshes.
[*] Missing cinematic skipping added: World 1 Level 1 - Skip Excaliboar after the fight.
[*] Missing cinematic skipping added: World 2 Level 2 - Skip Excaliboar after the fight.
[*] Missing cinematic skipping added: World 3 Level 3 - Skip Excaliboar after the fight.
[*] Missing cinematic skipping added: Coach P. cinematic - Skip and gives air dash power.
[*] Missing cinematic skipping added: World 2 Pork King - Skip cinematic after the fight.
[*] Missing cinematic skipping added: World 6 Level 3 - Skip Mt. Broc.
[*] Speedrun clock now plays a hand moving animation.
[*] Crushers play warning sound effect.
[*] Crushers in 1-3 are now mute when you find the hologram and return to unmute.
[*] Enhanced audio for UNAGI boss fight.
[/list]

[h1]FIXES[/h1]
[list]
[*] Bacon Man’s Sky Divide sound effect is more fiery.
[*] Ground Pound sound effect is now properly setup for SFX volume changes in menu.
[*] Fixed issues where you can get stuck crouching under certain objects with low ceilings.
[*] Fixed Mozzarachnid spawning string from clipping through ceiling.
Boosted Pork Tank’s HP.
[*] Enemies dying by spiked death volumes now play the correct sound, not Bacon Man’s death sound effect.
[*] XP required to level up slightly curved upwards for earlier levels.
[*] Equip slot UI which was hidden is now visible.
[*] Lobster Knight now sports more HP.
[*] Pork King fight form one now has more HP.
[*] Level collision fixes with World 2 Level 2.
[*] Fixed World 2 Level 3 performance issues in certain areas.
[*] Removed excess collisions from certain static meshes.
[*] In the the second fight with Excaliboar, he now has a little more HP.
[*] Fixed spawning at the top of Level 1 if you die before getting a checkpoint.
[*] Can now hit Melon Maiden in her off center collision box.
[*] Speedrun clock in World 3 Level 4 is in the foyer instead of the main HUB.
[*] Crusher plays the correct death sound.
[*] Final boss plays win song at the correct time.
[*] Sir Wheat will now properly turn around when behind him.
[*] Fixed issue where percentage of game completed was missing.
[*] Excaliboar no longer has issues entering Phase 2.
[*] Boss Broc hitbox issues resolved.
[/list]

notes.title: New Bacon Man Characters Trailer!
notes.notes:
[h1]With one month to release, Bacon Man gets a new characters trailer that will leave you hungry for more.[/h1]

Bacon Man, the meatiest and greediest of all pork based video game heroes launches on Steam in one month; but he can’t fight alone! To take back his place as King of Meat Zone, he’ll need help from his friends.

The table is set, and the warriors of Nomround are hungry for action! Investigate Feta’s mysterious past, navigate harsh deserts as the magical Pan, and pal around with your best buddy Lard Lass.

Feast your eyes on the new Bacon Man Character Trailer!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=s-N20zrzJy0

[h1]Release[/h1]
March 8th, 2018 (Steam, PC). At a later date, versions of the game will release for MacOS, Linux, and Xbox One, the all-in-one games and entertainment system from Microsoft.

notes.title: Bacon Man v1.3.1 Now Available to Private Beta Users
notes.notes:
Friends, this is a massive update. We've added World 3, which is by far the largest world in the game. We've also added boss fights! As always, please send us any feedback, and thank you for testing. 

Bacon Man v1.3.1

Changelog:
+ Added Unagi boss level to World 1
+ Added Pork King boss fights to World 2
+ Added World 3 and bosses

~ Fixed issues with player knock back being inaccurate
~ Fixed some UI chat bugs
~ Fixed bug where hanging then dashing will cause you to drop when under a hangable platform
~ Fixed double footstep sound issue
~ Fixed shop navigation and sell issues
~ Fixed crashes caused by dropping an object or enemy
~ Fixed some AI issues in World 2
~ Fixed troopers sometimes not throwing bombs
~ Fixed enemy respawn issues
~ Adjusted lighting and post process for various World 1 and World 2 levels

* Fixed Anti Ailment Ward pieces not showing up when equipped
